limitations: HML counterpart segments are schematic where OSM only maps one track; wye second connector includes an inferred diamond crossing. Exact turnout and crossover engineering is not verified.
New flyover deck display is 165 m CGVD2013, with smooth terrain approach transitions. This is an illustrative vertical profile; no survey-derived height is claimed.
Port Credit below-grade track descent is schematic and intentionally obscured by the terrain surface; the route locator remains available.

The unchanged physical representations use display slope caps to avoid bare-earth DTM bridge dips (GO 3.5%, HML 6%, bus 8%). These are schematic profile constraints, not surveyed or approved engineering grades.
GTFS route shapes are service paths. GO individual rails use City 2024 photogrammetric Railway lines and do not assert which track every scheduled train uses.
Transitway is existing. The Erin Mills–City Centre link includes highway and street running; no continuous dedicated busway is claimed.
Station markers are geographic locators, not new station architectural models. City Centre and North Service locators are approximate and carry explicit coordinate tolerances.

The displayed 403 guideway envelopes use mapped paired bridge track positions with 2 m outer margins from each track centre and 1 m structural depth. Deck width/depth are illustrative, and no unverified pier positions are added.

Service markings now obey normal occlusion. Source-based underground and underpass paths remain continuous in data but are hidden by foreground structures in 3D. Small local clearance is visual, not engineering.

visibilityGuide.method: Normal scene depth. Service markings follow each route physical profile with small support clearance. Overhead surfaces beyond a 0.65 m local support window are not used to raise a lower route.
visibilityGuide.viewerDepthPolicy: depthTest=true; depthWrite=true; renderOrder=0; opaque unlit system colour; ordinary scene occlusion.
visibilityGuide.renderPolicy: All service guides remain in the same scene and camera depth as buildings and terrain. No separate Alpha Over route scene.
visibilityGuide.underpasses: Tracks or markings below an overhead bridge, station roof, building, or terrain are intentionally hidden. This is physical occlusion, not a broken route.
visibilityGuide.scopeCaveat: Source profiles remain approximate. Exact engineering levels, inferred HML counterpart tracks and switch geometry are not certified.

physicalTrackColourPolicy: Neutral grey physical tracks. Semantic system colour belongs to separate depth-tested service markings.

priorColourRepair.method: COLOR_0 restored from full-city source attributes. POSITION and index arrays are byte-identical before and after repair; mixed bed and rail colours preserved.
priorColourRepair.scope: Historical first district colour repair, before the separate continuous service-guide edition. Its hashes describe that prior state only.

roadCrossingElevationRepair.method: Existing Transitway service routes only, associated by actual mapped pavement footprint and parallel route direction. Dedicated-busway segments match only mapped MISSISSAUGA TRANSITWAY profiles; highway association is limited to on-road-connection segments. The 8% continuity envelope is a display constraint. Road at a different level is not used as generic support. GO and HML source profiles are unchanged.
